fit.basis: Covers line-level review of a pull request, which no code-intel provider emits. `change risk` scores a revspec and `change impact` selects tests, but neither reads the diff for defects, so the two compose rather than overlap.

license.basis: Apache License 2.0 in plugins/code-review/LICENSE at the pinned commit; installation is by reference, so no file is redistributed from this repository.

security.basis: Component inventory reports one skill and zero agents, hooks, and MCP servers; it reads the diff and writes review text, declaring no repository mutation.

integration.basis: Skill-only surface costing about 20 always-on tokens; no repository file and no pipeline node change.

reversibility.basis: `claude plugin uninstall code-review@claude-plugins-official` removes it; the catalog entry is the only trace left in this repository.

routing.trigger: `code-intel change risk <base>..<head> --format json` reports a high or critical `review_priority` and the diff has not been read line by line.

fit.basis: Six single-axis reviewers, of which silent-failure-hunter, pr-test-analyzer, and type-design-analyzer answer questions the pipeline records evidence for but never adjudicates: swallowed errors, missing tests behind a changed file, and new type shape.

license.basis: Apache License 2.0 in plugins/pr-review-toolkit/LICENSE at the pinned commit; installation is by reference, so no file is redistributed from this repository.

security.basis: Component inventory reports one skill and six agents with zero hooks and zero MCP servers; the agents report findings and declare no repository mutation.

integration.basis: About 2,033 always-on tokens, the highest of the five, because six agent descriptions load into every session; its code-simplifier agent duplicates the standalone code-simplifier plugin.

reversibility.basis: `claude plugin uninstall pr-review-toolkit@claude-plugins-official` removes it; the catalog entry is the only trace left in this repository.

routing.trigger: `code-intel change impact --changed <path> --staleness advisory` returns an empty or partial test selection for a changed file.
`artifact query --type diagnosis.hospital-view` names a changed file whose finding is about error handling or fallback behaviour.
The diff introduces a new type, enum, or struct that crosses a module boundary in `code_evidence.agent_slice`.
A pull request needs every review axis at once instead of one targeted reviewer.

fit.basis: Answers the monolith rule the Sentrux gate can only detect: a file over 800 lines, or a function count over 25 in a file over 400 lines, is reported but never reduced. Every instruction line of this agent except its frontmatter description also appears in the pr-review-toolkit agent of the same name, which adds 22 more, so installing both is redundant.

license.basis: Apache License 2.0 in plugins/code-simplifier/LICENSE at the pinned commit; installation is by reference, so no file is redistributed from this repository.

security.basis: Component inventory reports one agent and zero skills, hooks, and MCP servers; it rewrites code it is pointed at, so the Sentrux session gate must bracket its edits.

integration.basis: About 64 always-on tokens for a single agent description.

reversibility.basis: `claude plugin uninstall code-simplifier@claude-plugins-official` removes it; edits it proposes are ordinary working-tree changes.

routing.trigger: A file the session touched exceeds 800 lines, or exceeds 25 functions in over 400 lines, and the Sentrux gate reports it without reducing it.

fit.basis: Its code-explorer duplicates what `code_evidence.agent_slice` and repowise already serve, but code-architect fills a real blank: the pipeline scores risk and selects tests and never proposes an implementation shape before the first edit.

license.basis: Apache License 2.0 in plugins/feature-dev/LICENSE at the pinned commit; installation is by reference, so no file is redistributed from this repository.

security.basis: Component inventory reports one skill and three agents with zero hooks and zero MCP servers.

integration.basis: About 238 always-on tokens; its code-reviewer agent name collides with the pr-review-toolkit agent of the same name, so invocations must be qualified by plugin.

reversibility.basis: `claude plugin uninstall feature-dev@claude-plugins-official` removes it; the catalog entry is the only trace left in this repository.

routing.trigger: A new feature must land in a module `get_risk` marks a hotspot and no implementation shape has been proposed yet.
A feature needs the full explore, design, implement, review loop rather than a single reviewer.

fit.basis: Its assess and map stages restate what `code_evidence.agent_slice`, `diagnosis.hospital` and `graph.code-intel-understand` already publish, so those overlap rather than compose. The blanks it does fill are real: extract-rules turns undocumented behaviour into Given/When/Then specs, and uplift reads breaking changes between two versions of one stack, neither of which any pipeline artifact carries. Aimed at COBOL, legacy Java/C++/.NET and monolith web apps, which is a wider target than this pipeline's current repositories.

license.basis: Apache License 2.0 in plugins/code-modernization/LICENSE at the pinned commit; installation is by reference, so no file is redistributed from this repository.

security.basis: Component inventory reports ten skills and eight agents with zero hooks and zero MCP servers. Its transform, scaffolder and uplift-migrator stages rewrite code, so those edits must be bracketed by the Sentrux session gate.

integration.basis: About 1,273 always-on tokens, the second highest of the six, because ten skill descriptions and eight agent descriptions load into every session; its per-stage on-invoke cost reaches 8.8k for modernize-uplift.

reversibility.basis: `claude plugin uninstall code-modernization@claude-plugins-official` removes it; its staged artifacts are ordinary working-tree files an operator reviews before keeping.

routing.trigger: `artifact query --type diagnosis.hospital-view` selects `surgery_plan` for a module, so the rewrite is agreed and only its shape is open.
A module must be rewritten or replaced and `change impact` finds no test that pins its current behaviour.
`orchestration/toolchain-versions.v1.json` or a dependency manifest pins a runtime or framework major version behind the target, and the move is same-stack rather than a rewrite.

fit.basis: The pipeline publishes no security artifact at all: `diagnosis.hospital` scores defect, maintainability, and performance and has no vulnerability dimension, so this is a blank rather than an overlap.

license.basis: Not Apache 2.0. plugins/claude-security/LICENSE at the pinned commit is a proprietary Anthropic grant limited to internal use with Claude Code, forbidding distribution of the plugin or any modified version and forbidding use with or to develop a non-Anthropic product. Binding it by reference avoids the distribution clause; an operator must still decide whether pipeline-routed use stays inside the internal-use grant.

security.basis: Component inventory reports seven agents plus a UserPromptExpansion hook, and patch-generator writes fixes into a scratch workspace clone staged as a patch, so it is the only one of the five whose default flow produces file mutations.

integration.basis: About 642 always-on tokens and a scan-then-patch workflow whose patch stage must be bracketed by the Sentrux session gate before anything is applied.

reversibility.basis: `claude plugin uninstall claude-security@claude-plugins-official` removes it; patches are staged for review and are not applied without an operator step.

routing.trigger: A release or an externally reachable change needs a vulnerability read that no `diagnosis.*` artifact provides.
